Relay 0.1.0-alpha.1 — source and licensing

Approved original code and scoped test data remain MPL-2.0; see LICENSE
and LICENSING.md. The thirteen icon files have separate MIT/Expat
copyright permission in ARTWORK_LICENSE.md (v1.0, 2026-11-19).
BRANDING.md v1.1 separately governs permitted product identity to the
extent of applicable rights; it adds no MIT/MPL/GPL copyright restriction.
ZXing and all other third-party terms/notices remain applicable.

Matching source and build instructions are supplied in
relay-0.1.0-alpha.1-source.tar.xz, with Cargo.lock and the separate
locked vendor/source materials listed in the release manifest.
Project source location: https://github.com/avihaytr/relay-source
The initial public commit alone does not include these packaging changes.
Only an explicitly authorized source update/release makes this candidate
available publicly; licensing adoption itself is not publication approval.
Private history, signing keys and passwords are intentionally excluded.
